cfg.notifications.emojiFree.description: Replace emoji in notifications with text markers ([ok], [warn], [err]) — for corporate chats and accessibility tools.
cfg.maxFileSizeMB.description: Maximum size of a single synced file in MB. 0 = unlimited
cfg.warnOnBinaryFiles.description: Warn before syncing files that look binary
cfg.showPreview.description: Show confirmation modal before adding files / running Pull / Push / full sync
cfg.syncSummaryOnStartup.description: After VS Code launch, run Pull on active workspaces and show a summary if anything changed
cfg.telemetry.description: Enable extension telemetry (aggregates: provider, workspace count, version). No file paths or names. Honors the global VS Code telemetry setting.
cfg.telemetryIngestUrl.description: Optional event ingest URL (POST JSON). Empty = VS Code's telemetry channel only, no external server. Only http(s), no credentials in URL.
cfg.encryption.description: Enable AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption for synced files. Key lives in SecretStorage.
cfg.aiMerge.description: Try AI-assisted 3-way merge for conflicts via vscode.lm (requires Copilot or compatible LM provider)
cfg.snapshotSchedule.description: Automatic snapshot schedule. Empty = disabled. Examples: 'daily 03:00' or 'weekly mon 03:00'. Local time.
cfg.codeLens.enabled.description: Show CodeLens with last-sync time and Pull button above tracked files
cfg.inlineConflictCodeLens.enabled.descr: Show inline CodeLens above git-merge marker blocks (<<<<<<< / >>>>>>>): Keep mine | Take theirs | AI merge
cfg.conflictHotZoneCodeLens.enabled.desc: Show a CodeLens flame on lines that have been part of resolved conflicts ≥ 1 time in the last 180 days (data from the conflict heatmap).
cfg.hoverDiffPreview.enabled.description: Show a MarkdownString hover over tracked files with sync status, last-sync age, and a Pull / Resolve action link.
cfg.smartConflictPrediction.enabled.desc: Show a status-bar warning when another machine has the active file marked as editing (soft-lock pipeline).
cfg.smartConflictPrediction.broadcastCur: What to publish in _machines.json.currentEditing. 'full' (default): literal relative path. 'anonymised': sha256(relPath).slice(0,8) — peers see 'machine X is on some-file' but not the path. 'off': do not broadcast — Smart Conflict Prediction loses pre-save warnings, post-fact warning still works via soft-lock pipeline.
cfg.canonicalHashAlgo.description: Canonical content-hash algorithm for the manifest. 'sha256' (default) keeps wire-compat with v1. 'blake3' switches to faster pure-JS BLAKE3 (requires @noble/hashes optional dep). 'dual' writes both hashes during the transition window — switch to 'blake3' once all peers have been syncing on 'dual' for ≥ 7 days. Use vscodesync.runHashAlgoMigrationCheck to verify.
cfg.ai.sessionSummary.enabled.descriptio: Allow `vscodesync.aiSessionSummary` to send local activity events (timestamps + workspace ids + relative paths) to the configured language model. Off by default — opt-in. The model provider (Copilot, local LLM, etc.) is the same one used for AI merge.
cfg.ai.suggestWorkspaceTags.enabled.desc: Allow `vscodesync.aiSuggestWorkspaceTags` to send tracked file paths to the language model for tag suggestions. Off by default — opt-in. Only relative paths leave the machine; file contents are not sent.
cfg.ai.pathMapper.enabled.description: Allow `vscodesync.aiPathMapper` to send manifest entries (relative paths only, no contents) to the language model for path-remap suggestions. Off by default — opt-in.
cfg.syncScheduleExtended.description: Extended sync schedule (v3.F). Examples: 'hourly', 'daily 09:00,12:00,18:00', 'weekly mon 09:00', 'workhours 30m' (every 30 min Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00). Empty disables. Engine wiring is opt-in; existing snapshotSchedule covers snapshots, this covers full sync.
cfg.autoPause.learnedSchedule.enabled.de: Auto-pause sync during learned 'quiet hours' (v3.M). VSCodeSync clusters your activity timestamps over the last 30 days into per-hour-of-day buckets and pauses background sync during the lowest-activity hours. Manual sync remains available. Off by default — opt-in.
cfg.massChangeGuard.description: Confirm before pushing a manifest that would tombstone many files (≥ 25 absolute or ≥ 50% of active). Disable to silence the modal.
cfg.presenceHeartbeatMinutes.description: Live presence heartbeat: periodically refresh lastSeen in _machines.json. 0 = disabled. Recommended 5 (~12 req/h).
cfg.backup.secondaryProvider.description: Cross-cloud backup: secondary provider used for periodic mirror of manifests + _meta.json. Empty = disabled. Must be authenticated and different from the primary provider.
cfg.backup.intervalDays.description: Cross-cloud backup mirror interval (days). Default 7 = weekly.
cfg.showFileDecorations.description: Show sync status icons next to files in the Explorer
cfg.onedriveClientId.description: Azure AD public client ID for OneDrive sign-in (device code)
cfg.googleDriveClientId.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop) for Google Drive (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials)
cfg.dropboxAppKey.description: Dropbox OAuth app key. Leave empty to use the bundled one. Add redirect URI in your app console: http://127.0.0.1:8734/oauth-callback
cfg.yandexOAuthClientId.description: Yandex OAuth Client ID. Leave empty to use the bundled one. Redirect URI: http://127.0.0.1:8735/oauth-callback. Scopes depend on vscodesync.yandexUseAppFolder.
cfg.yandexUseAppFolder.description: Use Yandex.Disk app-folder scope (cloud_api:disk.app_folder, paths under app:/…). Files live under «Apps/{app_name}/» and are isolated from other apps. Re-authentication is required when this changes.
cfg.quickTransferTtlDays.description: How many days a one-shot Quick Transfer is kept in the cloud
cfg.compressUploads.description: Gzip-compress text files on upload; cloud blob gets the .gz suffix and `_meta.files[].wireGzip` flag. Disabled automatically when workspace encryption is on.
cfg.lineEnding.description: Line-ending normalisation for canonical hash and sync: lf / crlf / preserve
cfg.workspaceInactiveDays.description: If the latest lastSync among a workspace's files is older than this, prompt to archive on startup (0 = disable check)
cfg.batchAddWarnThreshold.description: Warn before bulk-adding more than this many files
cfg.pushOnCommit.description: Trigger push on git commit (Reliability phase)
cfg.conflictRules.description: Auto-resolution rules for conflicts: the first matching rule applies without asking the user
cfg.localBackupEnabled.description: Keep a local backup before overwriting on pull
cfg.localBackupRetentionDays.description: Days to retain files in vscodesync-local-backup
cfg.syncOnFocusDelayMs.description: Sync delay when window regains focus (ms, Reliability phase)
cfg.syncOnOpen.description: When opening a tracked file, pull if cloud is newer (silent conditional GET)
cfg.smartSuggestions.description: Analyse activity.json: hint to group frequently-synced files; early archive prompt (~60d) when workspaceInactiveDays > 60
cfg.activityRetentionDays.description: Days to retain Activity Feed records in ~/.vscode/vscodeSync/activity.json
cfg.requireMachineApproval.description: Require explicit approval for new machines joining a workspace
cfg.pauseBatteryThreshold.description: Pause sync when battery is below this percentage (0 = disabled)
cfg.webhooks.url.description: Public HTTPS URL for Microsoft Graph (e.g. ngrok → local port). Must match what the tunnel forwards to webhooks.localPort.
cfg.webhooks.localPort.description: Local HTTP port (127.0.0.1) to receive Graph validation + notifications. 0 = don't listen locally (external relay handles POSTs).
cfg.webhooks.fallbackAfterMinutes.descri: Watch Mode: if no push notifications arrive within this many minutes, fall back to interval polling and warn. 0 = never fall back due to silence (only while subscription is active).
cfg.webhooks.tunnelEnabled.description: Run the built-in smee.io tunnel for webhooks when Watch Mode + webhooks are on. Gives a public URL for OneDrive / Google Drive without a static IP.
cfg.gitBranchAutoSync.description: On git branch switch: Suspend VSCodeSync workspaces whose manifest gitBranch differs; activate + sync the matching ones. Requires the Git extension and gitBranch set per workspace (Set Git Branch for Workspace).
cfg.watchMaxIntervalSeconds.description: Maximum back-off interval in Watch Mode (seconds)
cfg.deltaThresholdKB.description: File size threshold (KB) for delta sync
